body.text: Confirming storage interface for task_store.py: 1) add_task(path, title) -> task dict, 2) list_tasks(path, include_done=False) -> list of task dicts, 3) complete_task(path, task_id) -> task dict. Task dict schema: {"id": int, "title": str, "done": bool}. Raises ValueError on invalid inputs/corrupt JSON. Is this agreed?
